no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not referred for review to an advisory committee, because outside expertise was not necessary. There were no controversial issues that would benefit from advisory committee discussion.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for the SPINRAZA (nusinersen) NDA209531 approval. The Summary Review states the application was not referred to an advisory committee because outside expertise was not necessary and there were no controversial issues warranting AC discussion; the Office Director memo similarly cites the strength of the efficacy findings and lack of safety issues, and the Cross-Discipline Team Leader review marks the Advisory Committee Meeting section 'Not applicable.' Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
